verdict.rationale: Independent reviews (TechPowerUp, Tom's Hardware) confirm the 9950X3D delivers class-leading real-world performance—best application performance beating even the 9950X, near-parity with the 9800X3D in gaming, and a 37% lead over Intel's flagship—reflecting the low-latency, high-clock characteristics that drive snappy interactive feel, not just vendor GHz claims. Missing for 10: explicit single-thread benchmark scores (e.g., Cinebench 1T) and direct commentary on desktop/UI responsiveness rather than gaming/application throughput.
